name: experimental_groups_field_order_metadata
sql:

select * from t where optional_groups({{pairs}}, col2 in ({{cv}}) and col1 = {{cv1}})
expect_sql: select * from t where (col2 in (?, ?) and col1 = ?)

name: experimental_groups_having
sql:
--(pairs blob)--
select col from t group by col having optional_groups({{pairs}}, sum(col) > {{cv1}})
expect_sql: select col from t group by col

name: experimental_groups_with_order_by_sort
sql:
--(pairs blob, $args.sort string)--
select * from t where optional_groups({{pairs}}, col1 = {{cv1}}) order by sort({{$args.sort}}, id = id)
expect_sql: select * from t where (col1 = ?) order by id
